text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies. 
The competitors cower before Mejiro 
Ramonu. Lamenting this state of affairs, 
Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Praising the contenders' strengths, then 
egging them on. Being treated as rivals 
rekindles their fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the stage was set. Dreaming of a 
fierce battle, Mejiro Ramonu heads into 
the race—
